subject: planner: refactor pattern dir output memo related logic (#52117)
summary: Change is a refactor-only extraction: moved cascades pattern/memo matching primitives (Operand/Pattern, EngineType/EngineTypeSet, GetOperand) out of `pkg/planner/memo` into a new `pkg/planner/pattern` package, then updated cascades optimizer/rule batches and memo `Group`/`ExprIter` to use it. Diff review of `Optimizer.findMoreEquiv`, `memo.ExprIter` iteration/reset logic, and rule pattern construction shows only type/package wiring changes (no rule semantics/conditions altered). Later history up to `origin/master` contains no follow-up commits touching `pkg/planner/{cascades,memo,pattern}`, so there is no later fix to incorporate.
